name: seo-console
description: Turn Claude Code into a senior product-marketing manager across every place a product gets discovered: Google Search Console, Google Ads, the App Store, Google Play, WordPress.org and real-user Core Web Vitals. Search analytics, striking-distance keywords, CTR gaps, cannibalization, store listings and conversion, App Store keywords and sales, Android vitals, on-page and whole-site audits, indexing coverage, PageSpeed, and timestamped snapshots you can diff. Google Ads reads cover campaigns, keywords, ad copy, assets, search terms, negatives and change history; its writes are dry-run by default, refuse a target that does not match exactly one thing, and read every value back after writing.
